_comment: ESPN's scoreboard exposes a numeric team.conferenceId but no conference name anywhere in the payload. These ids were confirmed live against sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/football/leagues/college-football/groups/<id> on 2026-11-14. Mostly FBS, plus any FCS conference that's actually shown up (an FCS team playing an FBS opponent still appears in the FBS scoreboard with its real conferenceId, e.g. 20 = Big Sky). An id that shows up here later and isn't in this map falls back to a generic 'Conference <id>' label in code rather than erroring - add it here when that happens.
